  "reasons": [
    "Under the fixed capital method, partners' capital accounts maintain a fixed credit balance from year to year unless additional capital is introduced or capital is withdrawn by agreement.",
    "Day-to-day transactions such as share of profit/loss, interest on capital, and drawings are credited or debited to the partners' current accounts, which may show either a credit balance (shown on the liabilities side) or a debit balance (shown on the assets side)."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Partnership Fundamentals",
  "syllabus_topic": "Fixed v/s Fluctuating capital",

      "condition": "The firm follows the fixed capital method of accounting for partners' capital.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",

    },
    {
      "option": "D",

  ],

      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "All items like share of profit or loss, interest on capital, drawings, interest on drawings, etc. are recorded in a separate accounts, called Partner’s Current Account.",
      "reason": "Profit share, interest and drawings are recorded in current accounts, not capital accounts."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The partners’ capital accounts will always show a credit balance, which shall remain the same (fixed) year after year unless there is any addition or withdrawal of capital.",
      "reason": "Accurately states the core rule of the fixed capital method."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",

      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "the partners’ current account’s balance shall be shown on the liabilities side, if they have credit balance and on the assets side, if they have debit balance.",

    },

      "reason": "A partner's current account debit balance is shown on the assets side."
